prerequisites: Sufficient statistical and methodical competences, usually acquired in two one-semester statistics/stochastics courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply Human Factors fundamentals to the content domain.
Identify various influences and determinants on work and interaction quality.
Knowledge of various methodological approaches for the investigation and evaluation of human-machine interaction.
Systematic analysis and classification of situational influences.
Systematic analysis of sources and types of errors.
Realistic assessment of systemic influences on the work situation in the medical environment.
Improvement of teamwork skills through knowledge of group mechanisms.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the field of Human-Machine Interaction
